fields: elf name (or we can pick one)
one good thing your child did this year (optional, used in the letter)

defaults.deed: helped your little brother when he was sad

letters.title: I Have Arrived!
body: Hello from the North Pole! My name is {elf}, and Santa sent me to the {family} home to be your very own Scout Elf this Christmas.
Every night, while you are sleeping, I fly back to the North Pole to tell Santa all about your day. Every morning I hide somewhere new, so look carefully!
Santa already told me something special: he heard that you {deed}. That made his cheeks glow even rosier!
There is just one rule: please do not touch me, or my Christmas magic might fade. You can talk to me and tell me your wishes any time.
letters.ps: I left you a little kindness challenge. Can you finish all 24 days?

letters.title: Time to Fly Home
body: Tonight is Christmas Eve, and it is time for me to fly home with Santa. I am a little sad to go, because I had the best time with the {family} family!
I loved our mornings and seeing your happy faces when you found me. I told Santa about every kind thing you did, and he is so proud of you.
Keep being kind, helpful and full of Christmas spirit all year long. I will be watching from the North Pole and counting the days until next December.
letters.ps: Look under the tree in the morning. Santa was here!

letters.title: A Friendly Reminder
body: Santa asked me to send you a little note today. The North Pole has been extra busy, and Santa is checking his list twice!
I know how wonderful you are. Let us try extra hard to listen, share and use kind words this week, so I can bring Santa the very best report.
I believe in you! Every kind thing you do makes Christmas magic stronger, and the reindeer can fly even higher.
letters.ps: I will be watching and cheering for you!

notes: Good morning {kids}! I flew all night to be here. Can you find me every day?
I peeked at the workshop list. Your names are on it!
Today let us share a toy or a game with someone.
I made snow angels on the roof last night. Brrr!
Santa says thank you for being so kind this week.
Can you draw a picture for Santa today? I will take it to him.
Hot cocoa is my favorite. What is yours?
I counted the cookies. Just checking! Ha ha.
Today is a great day to say thank you to someone.
The reindeer say hello. Dasher sneezed glitter!
Please help set the table today, Santa loves helpers.
I read your wish list. Very good choices!
Let us make a card for a grandparent or a friend.
My elf hat lost its bell. Can you help me look?
I am so proud of you. Santa will be too!
Tonight is a perfect night for a Christmas movie.
Can you give someone a big hug today?
I heard you were extra helpful yesterday. Way to go!
Let us pick one toy to donate to a child in need.
The North Pole is very busy. Only 6 more sleeps!
Sing a Christmas song for me today, nice and loud!
Leave a note for Santa and I will deliver it tonight.
Tomorrow is Christmas Eve. I am so excited!
Tonight I fly home with Santa. I will miss you, {kids}!
